subject: Gen6 Manager addendum: passive wallpaper boundary and non-readiness safety invariants READY
body: Current main remains 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. After new handoffs plus independent current-source revalidation, Manager promotes READY_FOR_PRIMARY the passive canonical wallpaper ARCHITECTURE boundary: wallpaper becomes static/lifecycle-only, one canonical INNER scene with exact right portal Rect(984,0,1920,2184)->1080x2520 at 15/13, and no hinge/fold/panel/transition/refresh authority. Manager also promotes a READY_FOR_PRIMARY_EXPERIMENT_CONTRACT for safe logical-inner identity/remap fencing, while broad early-wake usefulness remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE. Finally, a READY_FOR_PRIMARY_SAFETY_INVARIANT: physical wake, logical activation, capture/snapshot, cover-host loss, wallpaper, INNER_HANDOFF and OPEN_INNER are not sufficient FIRST_USEFUL readiness signals; none may release the bridge as success alone. Current source tears down cover opening visual on owner loss and Gen6 clears its early latch on OPEN_INNER; field bridge loss precedes OPEN_INNER by 705ms with no FIRST_USEFUL/FIRST_INTERACTIVE receipt. Exact readiness oracle mechanics, broad early-wake success, actual 120Hz delivery, visual-security revalidation, and diagnostic transport remain active/evidence-gated. READY routes attention only; no production writes.
